concept.name: Target variable
concept.definition: The response variable whose conditional value, probability, or class a supervised model is fitted to estimate.
concept.intuition: It controls what information the model receives and in what numerical representation.
concept.mechanics: Choose an economically meaningful horizon, construct it from future outcomes relative to each feature row, and exclude it from the input columns.
concept.failure_modes: Fitting the operation on the full dataset leaks future information; revisions, outliers, and missing values can also distort results.
concept.misconceptions: A cleaner or rescaled dataset is not automatically more truthful; transformations must preserve timing and economic meaning.
concept.example: For a regression model, the target is the next five-day excess return in decimal form.
